Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A cell comprising: a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide derived from a bacterial species different from the host cell.

Claim 2 (Currently Amended): The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment is self-assembled in vivo under conditions that promote assembly.

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment further comprises at least one targeted enzyme that catalyzes a specific biochemical reaction.

Claim 4 (Currently Amended): The cell of claim 3 wherein the non-native compartment comprises a plurality of different targeted enzymes, each having distinct catalytic activities.

Claim 5 (Currently Amended): The cell of claim 4 wherein the at least one targeted enzyme comprises a compartment-specific targeting signal sequence.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): The cell of claim 1 wherein the BMC polypeptide comprises a Eut polypeptide.

Claim 7 (Currently Amended): The cell of claim 6 wherein the Eut polypeptide comprises a EutS polypeptide.

Claim 8 (Currently Amended): The cell of claim 1 wherein the proteinaceous shell comprises a plurality of different BMC polypeptides derived from different bacterial species.

Claim 9 (Currently Amended): The cell of claim 8 wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides comprises BMC polypeptides from different BMC operons.

Claim 10 (Currently Amended): The cell of claim 8 wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides comprises BMC polypeptides that are functionally distinct.

Claim 11 (Currently Amended): The cell of claim 1 wherein at least one BMC polypeptide comprises an affinity tag for purification purposes.

Claim 12 (Currently Amended): A method comprising: introducing into a host cell a polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide, thereby producing a transformed cell; and growing the transformed cell under conditions effective for the transformed cell to express the polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide and produce a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising the at least one BMC polypeptide, wherein the method is employed to enhance metabolic activity.

Claim 13 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 12 wherein the host cell comprises a bacterium.

Claim 14 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 13 wherein the bacterium comprises a member of the family Enterobacteriaceae.

Claim 15 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 14 wherein the member of the family Enterobacteriaceae comprises E. coli.

Claim 16 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 13 wherein the bacterium comprises a member of the family Shewanellaceae.

Claim 17 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 12 wherein the host cell comprises a yeast.

Claim 18 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 17 wherein the yeast comprises a member of the family Saccharomycetaceae.

Claim 19 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 18 wherein the member of the family Saccharomycetaceae comprises Saccharomyces cerevisiae.

Claim 20 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 12 wherein the host cell comprises an alga.

Claim 21 (Currently Amended): A method comprising: providing a cell comprising a non-native compartment comprising: a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, and at least one enzyme that catalyzes conversion of a substrate to a product; and growing the cell under conditions effective for the at least one enzyme to catalyze conversion of the substrate to a product, wherein the method is employed to produce a desired biochemical product.

Claim 22 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 21 wherein the product comprises a bioactive product.

Claim 23 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 21 wherein the product comprises a drug or a drug precursor.

Claim 24 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 21 wherein the product comprises a biofuel or a precursor of biofuel production.

Claim 25 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 21 wherein the at least one enzyme catalyzes a step in degrading or detoxifying a toxic substrate.

Claim 26 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 21 further comprising isolating at least a portion of the non-native compartments.

Claim 27 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 26 wherein at least a portion of the non-native compartment comprises an affinity tag and isolating at least a portion of the non-native compartments comprises contacting a sample comprising the non-native compartments with an affinity substrate having selective affinity for the affinity tag.

Claim 28 (Currently Amended): The cell of claim 1 comprising a plurality of compartments, each compartment having distinct functional roles.
